name: x-post
description: Write an X (Twitter) post from a raw idea using 21 proven hook formulas, in the user's own voice, counted the way X counts characters and humanized so it does not read as AI. Use whenever the user wants a tweet, an X post, a hook, "post about X", "turn this into a tweet", a long post for Premium, or asks for hook options. Produces three scored hooks, one full draft, and a copy-ready block that is never published without an explicit yes.

findings.excerpt: python3 hookscore.py --hook "one line"     # five-property hook panel + formula name
printf '%s\n' "hook one" "hook two" "hook three" | python3 hookscore.py -
